title: Golden Gate Bridge Ko Har Saal 10,000 Gallons Paint Kyun Lagta Hai? 🌉 #shorts
idea: The Golden Gate Bridge is continuously painted using thousands of gallons of paint each year to protect it from the corrosive salt air.

lines.text: Golden Gate Bridge ko har saal paint karna padta hai!
Kya aapko pata hai ki isme 10,000 gallons paint lagta hai?
Yeh amazing bridge salt air se bachane ke liye rangaa jata hai.
Iska iconic international orange color ise fog mein bhi dikhata hai.
Itna bada maintenance kaam dunya mein shayad hi kahin hota hai!
Kya aapne kabhi yeh bridge apni aankhon se dekha hai?

youtube.title: Golden Gate Bridge Ki Yeh Hairaan Karne Wali Baat Jaante Ho? 🌉 #shorts
youtube.description:
Jaanhiye Golden Gate Bridge ke baare mein ek aisi hairangeez baat jo aapko hairaan kar degi! Har saal isko paint karne mein lagte hain hazaaron gallons.

#goldengate #bridge #facts #engineering #shorts

facts.claim: The bridge is painted continuously, requiring approximately 10,000 gallons of paint each year to protect it from the corrosive salt air.
